title: Goleta School of Ballet
specs: Goleta Ballet Theatre junior training company prepares students for professional careers
Level placement based on age as of September 1st for Children's Division
Placement class or evaluation required for Level 2 and above
Students must be 3 years old by September 1 for Pre-Ballet
gap: Tuition prices for classes and summer programs not stated
blurb: Students attend structured ballet classes divided into Children's, Student, and Pre-Professional divisions based on age and skill. The school offers summer Dance Camp and Summer Intensive programs for various levels. Goleta Ballet Theatre is a junior training company for selected students preparing for professional careers.
extraNote: Consistent attendance mandatory; notify in advance of missed classes · Non-refundable $30 yearly registration fee due at enrollment · Deposit required to hold place in Dance Camp and Summer Intensive, deducted from tuition · Withdrawal allowed anytime with prior month notice · Parents not allowed inside studios; viewing through glass doors only · No food or drink except water in studios or lobby
